theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (v : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P) (pL : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid (d + 1)) (U : Set (Euclid (d + 1))) (S F : Set (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (d + 1)) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)), Orthonormal ℝ v → (∀ (x : Euclid P) (i : Fin (d + 1)), pL x i = inner ℝ (v i) x) → IsOpen U → MeasurableSet F → F ⊆ S → (∀ K : Set (Euclid (d + 1)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IsCompact (S ∩ pL ⁻¹' K)) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ξ x β| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm β) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), Z ω = ∫ x in F, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U (d + 1), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (d + 1), Y ω = ∫ x in F, ξ x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (d + 1)) (d + 1)) (pL x)).compContinuousLinearMap pL) ∂μ) ∧ Y.massOn U ≤ μ (F ∩ pL ⁻¹' U) ∧ (∀ W : Set (Euclid (d + 1)), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → Y.boundary.massOn W ≤ Z.boundary.massOn (pL ⁻¹' W)) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U (d + 1), ∃ ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), ∀ x ∈ S, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (d + 1)) (d + 1)) (pL x)).compContinuousLinearMap pL
